bodyHtml:
About IAPMO R&T｜Aquasky

IAPMO R&T is North America’s premier plumbing and mechanical product certification agency. It is accredited by American National Standards Institute (ANSI), Standards Council of Canada (SCC) and entidad mexicana de acreditación, a.c. (ema) along with recognition by Comisión Nacional del Agua (CONAGUA).
IAPMO R&T understands the importance of “speed to market” and tailors turnaround times to meet almost any deadline, never compromising the quality of service nor strength of the listing to do so. IAPMO R&T staff works with clients around the globe to provide flexible, local resources to accommodate their needs.

Aquasky PUMPLUS and THERMAL-PLUS products are certified by IAPMO with US pumping code PS 88 and NSF 61 drinking water standard. 

NSF 61 is the drinking water device certification from NSF International. The NSF 61 is one of the difficult standards to get for water devices. 

To be able to have PS 88, the NSF 61 standard is required. 

The IAPMO PS 88 certification requires field audition every 6 months and product testing every two years. The UPC shield marking is the protection of the user which means Aquasky pressure tank is a safe and quality device for the thermal expansion system and the well water system. 

Aquasky is building products that everyone can trust, and qualify by a world-leading organization.
